rows.S_justification: Spoofed RF source can inject false telemetry on satcom link.
rows.T_justification: Tampering possible if encryption keys are compromised.
rows.R_justification: Limited non-repudiation on RF downlink traffic.
rows.I_justification: Sensor and health data highly sensitive ISR payload.
rows.D_justification: Jamming or denial disrupts critical ISR downlink.
rows.E_justification: Boundary crossing allows potential privilege abuse via spoofed frames.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed uplink commands can hijack flight control.
rows.T_justification: Tampered commands directly affect vehicle safety.
rows.R_justification: Limited audit of RF command origin.
rows.D_justification: Loss of uplink prevents mission abort or control.
rows.E_justification: Compromised auth token enables elevated command execution.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed ground station can feed false mission data.
rows.I_justification: Decrypted frames expose sensitive mission content.
rows.D_justification: Disruption delays intelligence dissemination.
rows.E_justification: Limited escalation path through TLS endpoint.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed analyst workstation can issue rogue tasking.
rows.R_justification: Operator session logs exist but are incomplete.
rows.D_justification: Loss of tasking channel delays mission changes.
rows.E_justification: Valid session can escalate to payload control.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed maintenance set can send unauthorized BIT commands.
rows.T_justification: Tampered commands affect vehicle health state.
rows.D_justification: Flood of queries can saturate bus.
rows.E_justification: Valid session token enables deeper maintenance access.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed source can inject false HUMS records.
rows.I_justification: Flight logs contain sensitive mission history.
rows.D_justification: Bus saturation prevents timely download.
rows.E_justification: No direct privilege escalation on this interface.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed load station can deliver malicious software.
rows.T_justification: Tampered package executes on payload controller.
rows.D_justification: Corrupt load can brick payload functions.
rows.E_justification: Successful load grants code execution privileges.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed dissemination gateway can push rogue packages.
rows.T_justification: Unsigned or altered packages bypass integrity checks.
rows.D_justification: Flood can delay legitimate software distribution.
rows.E_justification: Valid signature allows code execution on target.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed recorder can inject false logs.
rows.I_justification: Logs contain system health and fault data.
rows.D_justification: Flooding delays log aggregation.
rows.E_justification: No privilege escalation via log sync.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed KMM can distribute false keys.
rows.T_justification: Tampered keys break all link encryption.
rows.R_justification: Key rotation events have limited non-repudiation.
rows.I_justification: Key material directly exposes crypto boundary.
rows.D_justification: Key revocation flood disrupts all links.
rows.E_justification: Compromised keys enable full traffic control.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed GPS signals can supply false position.
rows.R_justification: No logging of internal GPS feed.
rows.D_justification: Loss of GPS feed degrades navigation accuracy.
rows.E_justification: No elevation path on internal UDP link.

rows.S_justification: Physical tampering required to spoof IMU.
rows.T_justification: SPI bus susceptible to bit-flip attacks.
rows.R_justification: No audit on internal SPI bus.
rows.I_justification: Raw IMU data has low sensitivity.
rows.D_justification: Loss of IMU data affects attitude control.
rows.E_justification: No privilege escalation on hardware bus.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed GCS can issue rogue flight commands.
rows.T_justification: Tampered commands directly affect flight safety.
rows.D_justification: Loss of uplink severs operator control.
rows.E_justification: Valid token enables elevated command access.

rows.S_justification: Internal PCIe link requires physical access.

rows.E_justification: No elevation on internal hardware link.

rows.S_justification: Internal I2C requires physical access.
rows.D_justification: Bus contention can block key writes.
rows.E_justification: No privilege escalation on internal bus.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed remote ops can request diagnostics.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed LRU can return false status.

rows.S_justification: Spoofed port can inject false HUMS.
